Bihar Bypoll Sees Political Figures Vie for Bankipur Seat

The Bankipur constituency in Bihar is set for a by-election, featuring prominent political figures. Prashant Kishor has claimed his 'Jan Suraj' movement's entry has caused the BJP to become nervous. Reports indicate a direct contest between Kishor and Samrat Chaudhary, with local sentiment suggesting a desire for change from established political families.
